\[
\frac{\binom{R}{2} + \binom{B}{2}}{\binom{N}{2}} = \frac{1}{2}
\]

Rewriting the combinations in terms of \( R \) and \( B \):
\[
\frac{\frac{R(R-1)}{2} + \frac{B(B-1)}{2}}{\frac{N(N-1)}{2}} = \frac{1}{2}
\]

Simplifying, we get:
\[
2 \left[ R(R-1) + B(B-1) \right] = N(N-1)
\]

Substituting \( B = N - R \):
\[
2 \left[ R(R-1) + (N-R)(N-R-1) \right] = N(N-1)
\]

Expanding and simplifying:
\[
2 \left[ R^2 - R + (N - R)^2 - (N - R) \right] = N(N-1)
\]
\[
2 \left[ 2R^2 - 2NR + N^2 - N \right] = N(N-1)
\]
\[

\]
\[
N^2 + 4R^2 - 4NR - N = 0

\]

\[
